title: The Texas Housing Market is at WAR
description:
Buying or Selling a Home ANYWHERE in Texas? Let's Talk! We Can Help. https://calendly.com/realestatestephen/30min?month=2024-07
⬆️⬆️⬆️⬆️⬆️⬆️⬇️

The Texas housing market is locked in a brutal triangle deathmatch between homebuyers, home sellers, and homebuilders. Inventory is surging, builders are throwing out huge incentives, and sellers are struggling to hold onto their home values. But what does this mean for YOU as a homebuyer or seller in Texas?

In this video, I break down the latest housing market data for Austin, Dallas, Houston, San Antonio, and Killeen/Fort Cavazos, so you know exactly where you stand. Whether you're looking to buy, sell, or invest, I’ve got the insights you need to make a smart move in 2025!

📌 Key Highlights:
✅ Texas home inventory is at pre-pandemic levels – What does this mean for prices?
✅ Builders are offering major incentives – Are they worth it?
✅ Home sellers are holding firm on equity – But are they overpriced?
✅ Market breakdown for Austin, Dallas, Houston, San Antonio & Killeen
✅ Should you buy now or wait?
